The standard of care and service from this practice has been extremely poor.

Since the introduction of the online consultation system, patients were told it would improve access to appointments and reduce waiting times, as well as ease the difficulty of getting through by phone each morning. Unfortunately, this has not been my experience.

I submitted an online consultation form and was only told that my request had been triaged and that an appointment would be arranged when available. When I finally received an appointment date — three weeks after the initial consultation — I received multiple reminder texts, only to arrive at the surgery and be told the appointment had been cancelled.

This level of delay and disorganisation is unacceptable, especially given the nature of my symptoms and the fact that I have been raising these concerns for over two years.
